svg.title: One session ID holds several runs, one conversation and one live browser
svg.desc: Runs in one session execute one after another and share the conversation and workspace. 1: runs.create(task) starts the session and its browser. 2: runs.create with the same session_id continues the conversation and reuses the live browser. 3: sessions.send_message with interrupt=False queues behind a busy run and starts when run 2 ends. 4: the browser stops 120 s after the last run ends, unless kept alive; keepAlive 120 to 14400 s (max 4 h) is billed as browser time. 5: a run after the stop keeps the conversation and workspace and gets a new browser.
svg.text: one session, any number of runs
Follow up, same conversation and browser
Stops 120 s after the last run, unless kept alive
keepAlive 120–14400 s, billed as browser time
A run after the stop gets a new browser
